newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India GDRs find support after dips.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India GDRs find support after dips.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts (GDRs) eased on Wednesday but traders said buyers were willing to come in at the lows.
Prices initially dropped in line with a lower Bombay market which registered its biggest fall since last month's budget had initially sent prices surging.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index lost 1.22 percent by the close to 73.86, while the premium rose to 16.89 percent from Tuesday's 15.59 percent.

After the initial drop in GDRs, much of it led by market makers, prices bounced back to opening levels and then turned "At the lower levels, the GDRs are well supported. There is still a view that the budget was positive," one trader said.
Reliance was unchanged while SAIL slipped 15 cents to $8.375. Hindalco rose 52 cents to $31.15.
In other Asian markets, the Capel Taiwan GDR Index continued to drop, falling 3.36 points to 118.14. The discount to the local market was 0.47 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended 1.83 points lower at 57.00, while the premium fell to 39.20 percent from 42.94 percent.
